evidence.outcome: Save Create posts to the expected endpoint, but redirected stderr is not drained concurrently and creation has no timeout or bounded diagnostic output.
Current token redaction can leak the token suffix, and the first-run setup code is written to startup logs.
API error responses are inconsistent and many errors lack a stable actionable body or correlation context.
The shared frontend action path renders mostly global generic errors, while Save Create does not reliably populate page-local error state.
The logs endpoint returns only the in-memory queue, with weak persisted-log and operation-lifecycle visibility.

next_slice.summary: Implement a safe structured error contract and redactor, repair Save Create process capture/timeout/diagnostics, improve unified logs, and add page-local actionable error rendering. Keep secrets out of all responses and logs.

result: High-risk defects are concentrated in Save Create process handling, secret-safe logging, inconsistent API errors, and generic frontend error rendering. Route a bounded developer slice covering the four linked implementation areas with focused regression tests.
